steps.code:
# Get following artists with pagination
access_token = login_result['access_token']
all_artists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    artists = apis.spotify.show_following_artists(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not artists:
        break
    all_artists.extend(artists)
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total artists: {len(all_artists)}")
print(all_artists)
